en.title: Sewing Machine Music Box Gift, Wooden Vintage Musical Box Christmas Anniversary Birthday Gifts for Mom Wife Grandma Friend Wind Up Mechanical Melody Fur Elise
bullets: ♬SEWING MACHINE MUSIC BOX: Unique design vintage mini sewing machine music box brings great melodious melody of the song tune and make a nice atmosphere on home,sewing room,and it will bring back the good memories of the past.

♬MUSIC BOX BEST GIFT: A perfect gift for sewers, music lovers, It's the best gift for grandma, grandfather, dad, mom,aunt, relatives, lover,suitable be a birthday gift, Christmas gift, Valentine's Day gift or Thanksgiving Gift.
♬MELODY FUR ELISE: Our sewing machine music box brings famous tune: Fur Elise.

♬WIND UP MUSICAL BOX: Twist the switch by hand to start the motion and tune, As the tune "Fur Elise" plays, the miniature sewing machine's treadle pedal moves up and down while the spool mouse sitting on top of it spins round and round.

♬SIZE AND MATERIAL: Wind-up clockwork design，No battery needed, high detail and texture,about 8.2 x 6.7 x 3.7inch. Our sewing musical box was made of high quality wood,non-toxic and non-irritating odor,pure mechanical operation.
